description: This file defines a React component 'ChartDataProvider' that manages data fetching and state for chart components in a Superset UI project. It handles loading form data, datasource, and query data, and provides the data or errors to child components via render props.

classes.name: ChartDataProvider
classes.description: A React PureComponent that fetches chart-related data and manages loading/error states, providing data to child components.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state and ChartClient instance.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Triggers data fetch when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Refetches data if formData or sliceId props change.

methods.name: extractSliceIdAndFormData
methods.description: Returns an object with either formData or sliceId based on props.

methods.name: handleFetchData
methods.description: Performs data fetching, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleReceiveData
methods.description: Handles successful data fetch, updates state and calls onLoaded callback.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors during data fetch, updates state and calls onError callback.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders children with current loading, error, or payload data.
